text_block_list.text: When I visited a bookstore in search of training books, I spotted two familiar Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's find it――
your ultimate, special fantasy novel!
choice_data_list: Are you looking for a book?
Are you looking for a book?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer.
Actually... they asked me to pick out
some new books for the library!

text_block_list.name: Library Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
—So, we're adding fantasy novels.
You seem to read a lot, Ms. Craft, so could you pick out some recommendations for us?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... I'd love to!
In that case, I have the perfect novel to recommend!
It's a story about a prince and a witch—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"A witch!? What what what, what's that about!
Tell me everything too!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Sweep-san's eyes sparkled with excitement...
so we're searching for it together.
choice_data_list: What kind of story is that?
What kind of story is it?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... It's about a lonely little witch girl
who meets a kind prince.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
A lonely witch works a miracle
for her prince—such a warm and tender story.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"That's it! That 'witch's miracle' thing!
It must be some super-sized magic!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to see just how amazing it is for myself!
Come on, Craft, let's go search!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... It doesn't seem to be here.
It's a really old book, after all...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Um, can we go to another
bookstore too?

text_block_list.name: Bookstore Clerk
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, but this book is out of print...
None of our branches have it in stock either.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Is that so...! Then an independent secondhand
bookstore might have it... I'll go look!

text_block_list.name: Small Business Owner
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, young lady, we don't have that in stock.
It's a pretty old book, after all...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much.
Hmm, well then—!

—However, even after searching bookstores all over town,
we couldn't find the book she was looking for.
The girls were starting to look tired too...
choice_data_list: ...How about going with your second most recommended book?
...Why not go with your second favorite recommendation instead?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: No! There's absolutely no way I'm accepting that!
choice_data_list: Still, it doesn't seem to be sold anywhere...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I said I'm reading it, so I'm reading it!
I won't be satisfied otherwise!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
I want to keep searching a little longer, too...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Sweep-san said she wanted to read it this much...
I'm so very happy.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I really want you to read it too.
Both Sweep-san and everyone else...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...It's a book full of memories from when I was little.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "The warm feeling in my heart when I turned that final page... I still remember it even now."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: To know such a gentle story exists... It gives me such a warm feeling, like I'm inside a dream.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: That's why I don't want to give up... absolutely not.
choice_data_list: ...Alright! I'm with you all the way!
...Alright! I'm with you all the way!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...!
...Ehehe, thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Now that's the spirit! Heheh...
We'll definitely track it down together!"

I browsed bookstores in the neighboring town with them.
And then... just how many shops
had we visited by that point?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"This is the last bookstore...!
Ah—"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Found it~!
Whoa... this is the cover!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You did it!
Let me read it already, Craft!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wah, turning a wasteland into a flower garden...!?
Amazing, amazing, it's so pretty!!
To think such incredible magic exists...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, thank goodness.
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to your refusal to give up!
It's all thanks to your refusal to give up, isn't it!
I'm sure everyone will read this book.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, thank goodness.
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to your refusal to give up!
It's all thanks to your refusal to give up, isn't it!
I'm sure everyone will read this book.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, my head was just so full of
wishing I could reach everyone... But, I'm sorry
for making you come all this way with me.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What are you apologizing for?
When it's something you can't compromise on, you have to stick to your guns no matter what!
choice_data_list: Maybe the two of you are surprisingly alike after all.
Maybe the two of you are surprisingly alike, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Well, I suppose you have some promise.
Still, you've got a long way to go to match me!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'll devote myself to training so I won't lose to Sweep-san! ...Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I hope so...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, when are we going to be able
to check out that book?!
We went through so much trouble to find it!

text_block_list.name: Library Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
"Well, it's fully booked...
Wait, Sweep-san, didn't you borrow it just the other day?"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Reading it just once isn't enough!
Jeez, when will it be my turn to read it again?!
